[[File:2026-Retro-GEMPC-Logo.png|thumb|right|320px|Official event logo for the 2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII).<ref name="overview" />]]

'''2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)''' was an open-registration Players Committee online match-play championship on GEMP in the [[Premiere - Death Star II]] format. Play ran from 15 June 2026 through 6 September 2026; the Players Committee news summary of final standings was published 10 September 2026.<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026/ 2026-09 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII) &ndash; July to Sept. 2026], starwarsccg.org (published 10 September 2026). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/2026_Retro_GEMPC_starwarsccg_org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026.pdf Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="overview">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86555 2026 Retro GEMPC Overview, Rules, Prizes, & Registration], forum.starwarsccg.org (opened 10 March 2026)</ref>

Timo Dusel won the event with Ralltiir Operations (Dark) and Hidden Base (Light). Jonny Chu finished second; Jeremy Christoffel third.<ref name="pc" />

== Format and schedule ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Platform:''' SWCCG GEMP at gemp.starwarsccg.org 
* '''Structure:''' Seeded '''double elimination''' match play. Each match is two games (one Dark, one Light) with the same locked decks; higher net life force advances (lost-pile count as tiebreaker).<ref name="overview" /><ref name="brackets">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86780 Brackets &amp; Tentative Timing for 2026 Retro GEMPC], forum.starwarsccg.org (14 June 2026)</ref>
* '''Bracket:''' [https://challonge.com/kapftrvm challonge.com/kapftrvm] (posted by the tournament director in the brackets thread).<ref name="brackets" />
* '''Timing:''' Official play ran '''15 June 2026 &ndash; 6 September 2026'''; brackets and the player list were finalized and play began on 15 June 2026, as recorded in Bill Bisco's kickoff email.<ref name="kickoff" /> Registration / locked-deck deadline 12 June 2026 (Pacific). Players generally had about one week per match; finals were scheduled for Sunday 6 September 2026 at 2&nbsp;PM EST.<ref name="overview" /><ref name="finals">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86962 2026 Retro GEMPC Finals &ndash; Sunday September 6th 2026 at 2PM EST], forum.starwarsccg.org</ref>
* '''Entry:''' Free ($0); open registration (no qualifier).<ref name="overview" />
* '''Locked decks:''' Dark and Light lists submitted before the deadline and used throughout (TD may allow early fixes for obviously broken lists).<ref name="overview" />
* '''Result reporting:''' Players posted match winners in the reporting thread.<ref name="report">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86782 REPORTING THREAD for 2026 Retro GEMPC], forum.starwarsccg.org</ref>

After a player poll, the bracket used standard double elimination in which the winners-bracket champion must be defeated twice.<ref name="brackets" />
